questions.stem: A security manager at a county courthouse is writing a policy that lists the phases of the incident response process from first to last. Which of the following shows the phases in the correct order?

choices.text: Preparation, analysis, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned
Preparation, analysis, detection, eradication, containment, recovery, lessons learned
Preparation, detection, analysis, eradication, containment, recovery, lessons learned
Preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned

reference.title: Incident Response Processes
reference.find: lifecycle is a seven-step process

questions.stem: At a garden supply company, the CIRT is cutting malware-infected order servers off the network as part of the containment phase. Which phase of the incident response lifecycle did the team complete just before this one?

choices.text: Analysis
Detection
Preparation
Eradication

reference.title: Incident Response Processes
reference.find: whether an incident has taken place

questions.stem: As a worm spreads across a boarding school's dormitory network, a new responder asks what goal the CIRT is working toward in the containment phase. Which of the following BEST describes that goal?

choices.text: Limit how far the incident reaches and how much harm it does
Remove the cause and install patches to restore a secure state
Discover indicators of threat actor activity on the network
Put the systems back into the business processes they support

reference.title: Incident Response Processes
reference.find: limits the scope and magnitude

questions.stem: Two weeks after a ransomware attack on a public radio station, the CIRT meets for the final phase of the incident response lifecycle. Which of the following should be the main focus of this meeting?

choices.text: Restoring the station's files from backup and testing them
Removing the ransomware and installing missing patches
Deciding which staff members to discipline for mistakes
Finding procedures or systems that could be improved

reference.title: Incident Response Processes
reference.find: analyzes the incident and responses

questions.stem: During a breach at an online bookstore, a stock clerk heard about the attack from one of the responders and posted the details on social media before the company had made any statement. Which of the following should the bookstore have set up during preparation to BEST prevent this?

choices.text: Case management tools that log incident details for responders
A senior executive who can authorize serious response actions
Playbooks that guide analysts through specific threat scenarios
A communication plan that controls who receives incident details

reference.title: Preparation
reference.find: prevent the unintentional release of information

questions.stem: A new kind of malware that no security vendor has seen yet has infected a pool supply company's file server. Which of the following would MOST likely reveal the infection?

choices.text: IDS alerts that match known attack patterns
Antivirus scans with the latest definitions
Firewall alerts on blocked inbound ports
Network traffic far above the baseline

reference.title: Detection
reference.find: deviations from baseline system metrics

questions.stem: A customer calls an electric cooperative to report a payment on her online account that she did not make, and the report goes to a first responder on the CIRT. Which of the following should the responder determine FIRST?

choices.text: Whether a genuine incident has taken place
Which countermeasures can contain the attacker
How the attacker was able to get into the account
Which backup should be used to restore the system

reference.title: Analysis
reference.find: determine whether a genuine incident

questions.stem: After alerts from a state park system's reservation server are confirmed as a true positive, a CIRT member identifies the type of incident and the camper records it affects so the case can be given a priority level. In which phase of the incident response lifecycle is the CIRT member working?

choices.text: Detection
Analysis
Containment
Lessons learned

reference.title: Analysis
reference.find: establishes incident category and impact

questions.stem: A bicycle maker's SIEM raises an alert that a payroll clerk's PC ran an unknown script and then connected to an address in another country. Which of the following would BEST help the CIRT decide what the alert means?

choices.text: Running a root cause analysis with the Five Whys model
Placing the PC's files and logs under a legal hold
Analyzing it with threat intelligence and a playbook
Tuning the alert rule to reduce false positives

reference.title: Analysis
reference.find: incident analysis depends on threat intelligence

questions.stem: Malware has infected the checkout terminals at one of a grocery chain's stores, so an analyst adds firewall rules that stop those terminals from communicating with any other system. Which of the following incident response phases is the analyst carrying out?

choices.text: Eradication
Containment
Detection
Analysis

reference.title: Containment
reference.find: prevent infected hosts from communicating

questions.stem: Attackers have been breaking into an engineering firm's laptops through a flaw in a remote access app that staff use, and the incident response team has started the containment phase. Which of the following should the team do during this phase?

choices.text: Delete the tools the attackers installed through the app
Restore the laptops from backups and return them to staff
Block the app from running on any of the laptops
Hold a meeting to review how the team handled the attack

reference.title: Containment
reference.find: prevented from executing on most hosts

questions.stem: An intruder has been signing in to a receptionist's account at a dental practice with a stolen password. Which of the following BEST describe the containment phase of the response?

choices.text: Deciding whether the odd sign-ins are a genuine incident
Keeping the intruder from reaching more patient records
Removing the intruder's tools and unauthorized changes
Temporarily disabling the receptionist's user account
Learning why the receptionist's account was easy to break into

reference.title: Containment
reference.find: disabling a user account

questions.stem: An analyst confirms that malware on a travel agent's desktop is deleting files on the agency's shared drive, and the office manager wants the files restored right away. Which of the following should the analyst do FIRST?

choices.text: Restore the deleted files from last night's backup
Disable the switch port the desktop connects to
Remove the malware from the desktop with antimalware software
Reinstall the desktop's operating system from a clean image

reference.title: Containment
reference.find: or disabling its switch port

questions.stem: An aerospace parts maker's incident response team wants to contain new malware on several engineering servers but keep studying the attacker's methods without revealing that the attack was detected. Which of the following would BEST meet these goals?

choices.text: Pull the servers' network cables to cut off all of their traffic
Copy the malware to a sandbox, then delete it from all of the servers
Move the servers to a honeynet segment that returns filtered output
Rebuild the servers from clean backups and return them to service

reference.title: Containment
reference.find: segment as a sinkhole or honeynet

questions.stem: A cinema chain's CIRT has blocked the attackers' addresses at the firewall, moved the infected payroll PCs onto an isolated VLAN, and confirmed that the incident is contained. Which phase of the incident response process should the team start NEXT?

choices.text: Recovery
Lessons learned
Eradication
Analysis

reference.title: Eradication and Recovery
reference.find: After an incident has been contained

questions.stem: After the attackers' tools were removed from a catering company's ordering servers, the web team reconnects the servers and reopens online ordering to customers. In which phase of incident response is the web team working?

choices.text: Containment
Recovery
Eradication
Lessons learned

reference.title: Eradication and Recovery
reference.find: ensures restoration of capabilities and services

questions.stem: After attackers broke into an aquarium's ticketing server, the incident response team is now in the recovery phase. Which of the following tasks belongs to this phase?

choices.text: Remove the backdoor the attackers left on the server
Disconnect the server from the network to limit the damage
Restore the server's data from backup and put it back in service
Review the team's response to find procedures to improve

reference.title: Incident Response Processes
reference.find: the restoration of data from backup

questions.stem: After a breach at a tire store chain is contained, the review team works back through the attack and finds that the attackers got in through an old vendor account that still had full admin rights. Which of the following BEST describes this effort?

choices.text: Threat hunting
Triage
E-discovery
Root cause analysis

reference.title: Lessons Learned
reference.find: root cause analysis or the effort

questions.stem: A regional bus company's CIRT must test how it would respond to a phishing attack at the lowest possible cost, with responders only explaining what they would do and no computer systems used. Which of the following should the team hold?

choices.text: Tabletop exercise
Walkthrough
Simulation
Lessons learned meeting

reference.title: Testing and Training
reference.find: least costly type of testing

questions.stem: Analysts at a staffing agency load a feed of known attacker TTPs into the SIEM and search a year of the agency's own logs for matches, even though nothing has set off an alert. Which of the following BEST describes this activity?

choices.text: Alert tuning
Threat hunting
Root cause analysis
Vulnerability scanning

reference.title: Threat Hunting
reference.find: to proactively discover whether

questions.stem: A furniture maker's IT staff copied files from the PC of an employee accused of fraud, but they followed no set procedure and kept no record of how they collected the files. Which of the following is the MOST likely result of these mistakes if the case goes to trial?

choices.text: E-discovery may be needed to rebuild the missing records
The files may be placed under a legal hold
Non-repudiation may stop the employee from denying the fraud
The files may not be accepted as evidence

reference.title: Due Process and Legal Hold
reference.find: ensure the admissibility of digital evidence

questions.stem: After a customer sues a home builder over a leaking roof, the builder's lawyers tell IT to stop the nightly job that deletes old project emails and logs until the case ends. Which of the following BEST describes this requirement?

choices.text: E-discovery
Legal hold
Data retention
Due process

reference.title: Due Process and Legal Hold
reference.find: a court case must be preserved

questions.stem: A forensic investigator is called to an eye clinic whose billing server is still running after an intrusion. Following the order of volatility, which of the following should the investigator collect FIRST?

choices.text: The server's logs on a remote log host
The files on the server's SSD
The data in the server's RAM
The server's backup tapes in storage

reference.title: Acquisition
reference.find: Contents of nonpersistent system memory (RAM)

questions.stem: A security analyst captures a system memory dump from a malware-infected laptop at a travel agency. Which of the following can the analyst MOST likely find by analyzing the dump?

choices.text: Logs kept on the agency's remote log server
Deleted files that remain in the drive's free space
Data hidden in the slack space of the laptop's drive
Processes that were running on the laptop

reference.title: System Memory Acquisition
reference.find: identify the processes that are running

questions.stem: After a break-in, an investigator uses live acquisition to copy the drive of a 24-hour pharmacy's order server so it can keep filling prescriptions. Which of the following is a risk of this method?

choices.text: Malware may detect the shutdown and use anti-forensics to hide
Threat actors may be alerted and have time to use anti-forensics
Cutting power at the wall socket may corrupt data on the drive
Memory contents are lost as soon as power is removed from the host

reference.title: Disk Image Acquisition
reference.find: alert the threat actor and allow

choices.text: Seal the original drive in a tamper-evident bag
Encrypt the image file with a strong key
Record a hash value of the image file
Attach the original drive to a write blocker

questions.stem: A toy company's investigators seize a designer's laptop in a case about leaked product plans, and several people will handle it before trial. Which of the following should they use to show who had the laptop, when, and where it was kept?

choices.text: A chain of custody form
A legal hold notice
A tamper-evident bag
A digital forensics report

reference.title: Preservation
reference.find: documentation records where, when, and who

questions.stem: For a patent lawsuit, a forensic examination copied 6 TB of data from a medical device maker's servers, and the maker's lawyers must remove duplicate files and share only the files that matter to the case with the other side. Which of the following BEST meets this need?

choices.text: E-discovery
Legal hold
Chain of custody
SIEM

reference.find: filtering the relevant evidence produced from

questions.stem: Analysts at a regional airport must sign in to the firewalls, the IDS sensors, the antivirus console, and each server one at a time to piece together what happened during an incident. Which of the following would BEST let them aggregate and correlate all of this data in one place?

choices.text: Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP)
Endpoint detection and response (EDR)
Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP)
Security information and event management (SIEM)

reference.title: Data Sources, Dashboards, and Reports
reference.find: correlate multiple data sources

questions.stem: The IT technician for a landscaping company wants to find every failed sign-in to the office's Windows server and every attempt to use administrator rights on it. Which of the following logs should the technician review?

choices.text: The server's System log
The server's Security log
The server's Application log
The firewall's traffic log

questions.stem: Malware on a veterinary clinic's front desk PC came from a USB drive that a visitor left in the lobby, and the malware never sent any traffic across the clinic's network. Which of the following data sources would MOST likely hold evidence of what the malware did on the PC?

Firewall logs
Packet captures

questions.stem: A worm spread through a known software flaw to several of a hardware store chain's servers, and an analyst needs to know which other servers are still missing the patch for that flaw. Which of the following data sources in the SIEM would BEST show this?

Vulnerability scans
Packet captures

choices.text: The firewall blocked an internal server from reaching an outside host
The firewall allowed an outside host to reach an internal server

choices.text: IPS/IDS logs
Vulnerability scans
Firewall logs
